bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; appropriating money for anti-human trafficking training.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

$....... in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of public safety for reimbursement of county attorney offices for the cost of attending anti-human trafficking training. The reimbursements must be proportioned equally among all participating Minnesota county attorney offices.
